# Documentation conventions (`doc/`)

`doc/` is the user-facing markdown reference. The docs site publishes it verbatim at each release tag, and an LLM agent reads one page at a time, so every page stands alone.

## File shape

```markdown
# Flows

One-line lead: what the page covers and when to use it.

- [Browser Flow](#browser-flow)
- [Related Documentation](#related-documentation)

<a name="browser-flow"></a>
## Browser Flow

<a name="related-documentation"></a>
## Related Documentation

- [Drivers](./drivers.md): which driver runs on which platform.
```

## Rules

- One `#` per file and it is the first line, with a one-sentence lead right after it: the site copies it as the page description in its generated `llms.txt`. Never skip heading levels.
- Layout is `doc/<section>/<page>.md`, two levels, lowercase `[a-z0-9-]`: `architecture`, `basics`, `getting-started`. No `doc/index.md`.
- Put `<a name="kebab-slug"></a>` immediately before every `##` and list the slug in the ToC under the lead.
- Open with the answer, state defaults and failure modes, and end a basics page with a Gotchas table (mistake, fix). `python3 tool/check-docs.py` must print 0 issues.
- Dart samples use `dart` fences and commands `bash`; every symbol, config key and `dart run magic:dowel` command exists in `lib/`. Tables are left-aligned (`:-----`) with identifiers in backticks.
- Links are relative `.md` paths inside `doc/`; a target outside `doc/` is never published. Backend facts follow `magic-starter-laravel`'s `src/routes/api.php`.
- Never in `doc/`: API dumps, changelog entries, marketing, internal architecture, counts, release-status wording, em or en dashes.

## Surface to page

| Change in `lib/` | Page |
|:-----------------|:-----|
| `SocialDriver`, `SocialAuthResult`, `GoogleDriver`, `AppleDriver`, `RedirectDriver`, `extend()` | `basics/drivers.md` |
| `SocialFlow`, `Pkce`, `Nonce`, `WebFlowSlot`, `SocialAuthException` codes | `basics/flows.md` |
| `social_auth.*` config keys, `SocialAuthButtons` overrides | `getting-started/configuration.md` |
| `social:install` flags, `social:doctor` checks, `install.yaml` | `getting-started/installation.md` |
| `SocialAuthManager`, the service provider, the starter bridge stub | `architecture/overview.md` |
